name: Stranglethorn Vale
_terrain: A 3.3.5 zone Turtle reworked lightly: a new subzone, Bloodsail Retreat, on the south coast (tiles 32_59 and 33_59), and new NPCs, quests and objects across the zone (Booty Bay, the Gurubashi Arena, Crystalvein Mine). The 3.3.5 Stranglethorn, its NPCs and quests stay; Turtle's additions are merged in.
_zone_from_335_tiles: Turtle's server maps miss the north of Stranglethorn (Nesingwary's camp, Kurzen's Compound): where Turtle did not change a tile, the zone and subzone come from the 3.3.5 tile.
_merge_region: own=changed: only the Stranglethorn chunks Turtle reshaped or gave its new subzone (Bloodsail Retreat, 25 chunks on tiles 32_59 and 33_59) are taken; the rest of the zone keeps its 3.3.5 ground. The South Seas / Great Sea areas (2338, 2339) belong to Stranglethorn in the area table but Turtle reshaped them for Gillijim's and Lapidis Isle: not the zone's own.
_exclude_creatures: Turtle's Blood Ring at the Gurubashi Arena (Vizlow, Trixy Gollavix, Gorug, the Arena Spectators, Bradley Steel, the four Bloody Gladiator vendors, Grenthor, Frixxle Blastvalve): its Arena Marks and Tokens of Blood come from Turtle's arena system (C++), so its quests and vendors cannot work. The Shellcoin scene in Booty Bay (Marlos Catos and the investors: Turtle's C++ coin exchange). The rented riding wolves at Grom'gol (rented_mount). Rufus Hardwick, Turtle's Survival trainer.
_exclude_gameobjects: The Shellcoin information panel and poster.
_exclude_quests: 39984 Rich and Convicted (a Shellcoin quest from Orgrimmar whose giver is not ported); 80401 To Build a Pounder (Oglethorpe; it follows Turtle's 80398 chain elsewhere and needs drops from Crimson Hammersmiths, which have no spawn); 55028-55031 and 55051, Shalgrig Pipeshack's chain between Booty Bay and Pazzle Brightwrench at Turtle's Sparkwater Port (new land in Durotar, not ported): it starts and ends there (55026, 55027, 55051). 42041 To Survive in the Jungle (Turtle's Survival profession).
_extra_spawns: Fazgel Mechaflame (Feralas; Mechaflame's Bargain and Highly Unexpected Event of Vil'do One-Tusk's chain), Wally Wisecrack (Hillsbrad; 'Wally Wisecrack' of 'Slip's chain), Yig Oilfuse (the Barrens; Delivery for Oilfuse / The Old Bonds).
_extra_gameobject_spawns: Lyvdia Dawnbird and the four Highborne Golden Statues (Feralas; Taking the Booty Home), the Mysterious Shipment (Breaking Contracts), the Steamwheedle Barrel (Tanaris; Smuggling Ale).
_extra_creature_templates: Quest credit dummies of the Bloodsail chain (Turtle's quest_*_dummy_triger creatures): 40174, 40186, 40187, 40172, 40180, 40354, 40362.
_force_display: Shadowhorn Stag: Turtle's model 21271 is not in 3.3.5 - the 3.3.5 stag (Crazed Stag's model).
_stock_spawns: manual/058 removes three 3.3.5 Skymane Gorillas (guids 802, 808, 919) that stood where Turtle built Bloodsail Retreat (Turtle removed them); the rollback restores them.
